intent: Agent work indicator above a response: animated "Thinking…" while running, then an expandable "Worked for {seconds}" that reveals the reasoning steps.
use_when: Above an agent response, to show it is working (thinking) or how long it worked (worked for {seconds}).
When the reasoning steps should collapse behind a disclosure the reader can expand.
dont_use_when: A transient app status or alert unrelated to agent reasoning — use Notification.
A fixed status or duration with no steps to reveal — use plain label text.

tokens.note: Type (13px/22px and 11px/18px, weight 450, tracking -0.032px), gaps (2-6px), dot size 4px, chevron size 14, and bounce timing (0.9s duration, 0.15s per-dot stagger) are hardcoded, not tokens.

a11y.aria-expanded: reflects expanded in the worked state; omitted (undefined) while thinking.
a11y.disabled: the button is disabled while thinking, removing it from the tab order.
a11y.focus: focus-visible ring bound to the focus-ring token.
